verdict.line: You lose if you let her stack Test of Spirit procs on you for free; you win if you poke her down with Q before she closes the gap.

brief.thesis: Illaoi has no gap closer besides W (Harsh Lesson)'s 400 range leap, so Gangplank's 625-range Q (Parrrley) outranges every tool she has to engage. The matchup is decided by whether you poke from max range and deny her E (Test of Spirit) stacks, or let her walk you down and trade in melee where her passive tentacles and W leap punish you hard.

theirWindow.when: E lands on you near a wall
theirWindow.what: If Test of Spirit's spirit tether sticks and you stay close to the spirit, you take the echoed damage on top of her follow-up W (Harsh Lesson) leap and any nearby tentacle swings. Walk the spirit away from her immediately instead of trading through it.

yourWindow.when: her E and W both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Both her damage tools (E's 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown and W's 4s cooldown) are down, so she has nothing but autos to answer your Q. Walk up and fire Parrrley freely — she can't punish the poke.

start.why: 52.9% win rate over 907 games (70.4% pick). The sustain and AD let you trade Q into her without losing the HP war while her passive tentacles chip you in melee range.

boots.why: 52.8% win rate over 377 games. Illaoi's damage is almost entirely physical — her passive tentacles, W, and E all hit as physical — so the flat auto-attack reduction blunts every poke she lands when she closes distance.

core.why: 61.4% win rate over 140 games when followed by The Collector then Infinity Edge. The mana restore on crit keeps your Q spam going all lane without running dry, which is the entire basis of your range advantage.
Part of the 61.4%-winrate path — the extra lethality and execute threshold let your Q poke start closing out kills before she can trade back in melee.
Caps the Essence Reaver into Collector into IE path at 61.4% over 140 games — crit scaling turns your ranged poke into real burst once she's forced to engage.

runes.keystoneWhy: 54.9% win rate (45.6% pick) — the burn stacks from your Q and auto pokes add up over an extended poke lane where you're rarely committing to full trades.

summoners.why: 54.1% win rate at 90.2% pick. Ignite punishes her lack of sustain tools once you get her low with Q poke, and it caps any attempt she makes to trade back and heal through her passive tentacles.

playing.title: Poke from max Q range
playing.detail: Parrrley has 625 range versus her 400-range W leap — stand just outside her engage distance and fire Q whenever she's in a minion-clear animation or walking up. She physically cannot punish you for this.

playing.title: Walk the spirit off her E
playing.detail: If she lands Test of Spirit, immediately move away from the tethered spirit rather than trading near it — staying close lets the echo damage and her follow-up W stack on top of what you're already taking.

playing.title: Stay off terrain near her passive tentacles
playing.detail: Her passive spawns tentacles on nearby impassible terrain that swing at anyone near her Vessels or E targets. Fight her in open lane space, not against walls or jungle entrances.

playing.title: Save W for her W-E combo
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy clears crowd control and heals you, but Illaoi has no hard CC in this kit — save the heal for straight damage trades after she lands W (Harsh Lesson) into E rather than wasting it defensively.

playing.title: Punish her E cooldown window
playing.detail: Test of Spirit's cooldown (16/15/14/13/12s) is her only real poke/engage tool outside autos. The moment it's down, you can walk up and freely stack Q's without fear of the spirit tether.

playing.title: Don't contest the solo push
playing.detail: She out-sustains extended all-in trades once her passive tentacles are active. Reset the fight to ranged poke if she starts walking you down — don't stand and auto-trade.

playing.title: Track Essence Reaver timing for all-in
playing.detail: Once Essence Reaver and The Collector are online, your Q resets and lethality let you force short trades that end before her passive tentacles can out-sustain you — look for these windows around level 11-13.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning on cooldowns, ranges, and trade windows is this brief's own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Although she does not have movement skills, her (E) deals a lot of damage. Stay behind minions to avoid being hit while contesting lane to gain control.
